scripts.deps:graph: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot apps modules packages services | dot -T svg > docs/deps-graph.svg
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml up -d --wait --wait-timeout 90 && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml run --rm storage-init
scripts.infra:up:kafka: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile kafka up -d --wait --wait-timeout 90 && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml run --rm storage-init
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile kafka --profile init down
scripts.infra:reset: sh -c 'printf "Delete ALL local infra data (volumes)? [y/N] "; read a; [ "$a" = y ] || { echo aborted; exit 1; }; docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile kafka --profile init down -v && pnpm infra:up'
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml exec -e PGPASSWORD=wb_app postgres psql -U wb_app -h localhost -d wise_biz
